statement:
The record shows an approved amount of USD 480,000, but policy PL-40 caps the payable value at USD 50,000.
Claim CL-7712 paid: **USD 50,000**, the maximum payable under policy PL-40.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the approved USD 480,000 exceeds the policy cap and gives the correct payable amount: "USD 50,000, the maximum payable under policy PL-40."
